operative_sections_inspected.quote: Confirm governing notice (R2); confirm stock; request approvals: RFQ/nomination of local plastics and electronics suppliers already proven on recent programmes, development budget; Legal review of supply agreement and notice terms; brief the plant on stoppage risk
Signed bridge/exit agreement; pre-build running at LPI; development kick-offs for both modules in parallel; tooling release plan agreed (not executed)
Plastics: tooling moved only once LPI’s plastics stock/bridge is secure (~25 days); trials and PPAP. Plastics ready ~late Jan to late Feb-2027 (3–4 mo)
Electronics: design, prototypes, safety certification. Ready ~23-Mar to 23-Apr-2027 (4–5 mo). Weekly status to CPO; gate reviews at design freeze and certification
Joint trial build of full lamp; PPAP; dual running with LPI; LPI final shipments about 30-Apr after local approval; no LPI stop until local is signed off

Scenarios: A – negotiated stay (reduced scope or volume reset): best, low probability. B – managed exit with bridge to Apr-2027: most likely target. C – partial bridge (buffer plus to 15-Jan-2027): needs air freight/premium stock and a hard look at line-rate; escalate. D – LPI stops on 13-Nov with no buffer: plant stoppage risk; contingency is any stock on hand, plus demand to resume supply under emergency terms, and a decision from the CPO on legal recourse (supply contract terms not in the records – Legal to review).
Authority: Any price change, volume commitment, advance payment or compensation needs prior CPO/Finance approval; none is granted by this document.

Not approved or confirmed: extension or bridge terms; new supplier RFQ/nomination and development budget; advance payments or price concessions; tooling release timing; legal position on notice. Not in records: stock levels, line-stoppage cost, LPI’s stated reasons, contract terms, supplier names/quotes, LPI price floor.
